hooks.name: End-of-session knowledge capture
hooks.description: At session end, prompts the agent to evaluate whether anything reusable was discovered and propose persisting it.

action.prompt:
Before this session ends: review what was discussed and discovered. If anything reusable was surfaced — an undocumented gotcha, a working recipe, a workspace convention, an architectural insight — propose persisting it.

Target options:
- Steering (.kiro/steering/*.md) — relevant broadly/often across sessions. Use inclusion: always for universal rules; inclusion: fileMatch for file-specific knowledge.
- Skill (.kiro/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) — specialized, occasional-use knowledge that won't come up most sessions.
- Extend an existing file over creating a new one when the topic overlaps.

If a bug was discovered this session, check whether a task already exists for it and create one if not — don't just document bugs, track them.

If nothing novel was discovered this session, say so briefly and move on — don't force it.
